pages.title: Standard Equipment
pages.text:
Standard Equipment




                                                                                                     Crafter
Interior – Seats
2-seater front passenger bench on the left, with storage compartment                                  •

Comfort seat on the right, in 1st row of seats                                                        •

Lashing rings for load restraint system                                                               •

Partition, with fixed window (with cab guard)                                                         •

Smokers' package: 12-V outlet with cigarette lighter, ashtray, and 4 beverage holders in dashboard    •

Storage package 2: overhead storage compartment with two 1-DIN slots and reading light                •
Exterior – Wheels
4 steel wheels 6.5J x 16 with 1.050 kg load, Silver                                                   •

Spare wheel (steel wheel) with original equipment tire, tool kit, and jack                            •

Exterior mirrors, power-adjustable and heated                                                         •

Standard roof – Medium wheelbase                                                                      •

High roof – Long wheelbase                                                                            •
Safety
Driver and front passenger airbag with front passenger airbag deactivation                            •

Side and curtain airbag for driver                                                                    •

eCall Emergency System                                                                                •

Advanced driver attention & drowsiness monitor                                                        •

First aid kit and warning triangle                                                                    •
Steering Wheel
Multi-function steering wheel                                                                         •
Doors
Left sliding door in load/passenger compartment                                                       •

Hinges for rear wing doors with increased opening angle (max. 270°)                                   •

Rear wing doors with windows                                                                          •

Rear window, heated, with rear window wiper and washer system                                         •
Assistance Systems
Lane keeping system Lane Assist                                                                       •

Park Distance Control in front and rear                                                               •

Electronic cruise control system (CCS)                                                                •

Cross Wind Assist                                                                                     •

Hill Start Assist                                                                                     •

Dynamic Road Sign Display                                                                             •

Forward collision warning with warning and braking reaction to vehicles, pedestrians and cyclists     •
Infotainment Systems
Radio Composition with 10-inch colour touch screen                                                    •

Preparation for We Connect and We Connect Plus                                                        •

Active Info Display                                                                                   •
Locking Systems
Central locking system Keyless Go without SAFELOCK                                                    •

Engine start-stop system with regenerative braking                                                    •

2 remote control folding keys                                                                         •
Climate Control
Air conditioning system with manual control in cab                                                    •
Warranty
5 year mechanical warranty or 100.000km whichever comes first                                         •

12 year anticorrosion warranty                                                                        •

3 year paintwork warranty                                                                             •
